**Database:** FAIT v2 PostgreSQL/MySQL

description:

FIRM's summarization pipeline (firm-transcriber Batch container) calls bedrock-agent-runtime directly to push meeting summaries to the Personal KB using StartIngestionJob API.

FIRM calls the fip-mcp service using the add_to_kb MCP tool for all KB ingestion operations, eliminating direct Bedrock client usage.

1. Update firm-transcriber to use HTTP client instead of bedrock-agent-runtime SDK
2. Replace StartIngestionJob calls with add_to_kb tool calls
3. Add Entra OAuth token acquisition for fip-mcp authentication
4. Update error handling to match MCP tool error responses
5. Test end-to-end meeting summary ingestion workflow

## Validation
Meeting summaries appear in Personal KB via fip-mcp with same metadata and content quality as direct Bedrock approach.

## Rollback
Revert to direct bedrock-agent-runtime calls if fip-mcp service is unavailable.
acceptanceCriteria: Given FIRM meeting processing, when summaries are generated, then they are ingested via fip-mcp add_to_kb tool; and when ingestion completes, then summaries appear in Personal KB with proper user scoping; and when fip-mcp is unavailable, then appropriate error handling occurs; and when comparing before/after, then summary quality and metadata are equivalent
